name: Temperature Converter
summary: Convert Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin instantly — private and client-side.
description: Enter a temperature in °C, °F, or K and see the other scales update. Negative Kelvin is rejected. No values leave your browser.

faqs.question: Why can’t Kelvin be negative?
faqs.answer: Absolute zero is 0 K. Values below that are physically invalid.

faqs.question: Is this uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Conversion runs entirely on your device.
